__1 To grow, increase. 
__2 To do, go or act quickly.

-Caus. 
__1 To gladden; किंनु चित्रमधिवेदि भूपतिर्दक्षयन्द्विजगणानपूयत [[Śi. 14. 35.]] 
__2 To make able or strong.

a. [दक्ष्-कर्तरि अच्] 
__1 Able, competent, expert, clever, skilful; नाट्ये च दक्षा वयम् [[

.]] 
__4 Honest, upright. 
-क्षः 
__1 N. of a celebrated Prajāpti. [He was one of the ten sons of Brahman, being born from his right thumb, and was the chief of the patriarchs of mankind. He is said to have had many daughters, 27 of whom became the wives of the moon, thus forming the 27 lunar mansions, and 13 the wives of Kaśyapa, becoming by him the mothers of gods, demons, men, and animals; see कश्यप. At one time Dakṣa celebrated a great sacrifice, but did not invite his daughter Satī, nor her husband Śiva, the chief of the gods. Satī, however, went to the sacrifice, but being greatly insulted threw herself into fire and perished; cf. [[

.]] When Śiva heard this he was very much provoked, and according to one account, himself went to the sacrifice, completely destroyed it, and pursued Daksa [Page0797-1] who assumed the form of a deer, and at last decapitated him. But Śiva is said to have afterwards restored him to life, and he thenceforward acknowledged the god's supremacy. According to another account, Śiva, when provoked, tore off a hair from his matted hair, and dashed it with great force against the ground when lo ! a powerful demon started up and awaited his orders. He was told to go and destroy Dakṣa's sacrifice; whereupon the mighty demon, attended by several demigods, went to the sacrifice, routed the gods and priests, and, according to one account, beheaded Dakṣa himself; [[

-29.]]] 
__2 A cock. 
__3 Fire. 
__4 The bull of Śiva. 
__5 A lover attached to many mistresses. 
__6 An epithet of Śiva. 
__7 Mental power, ability, capacity. 
__8 An epithet of Viṣṇu. 
__9 The right side or part; वामतो जानकी यस्य दक्षभागे च लक्ष्मणः 
__10 Ability, power, fitness. 
__11 Strength of will, energy, resoluteness. 
__12 Strength, power. 
__13 Bad disposition, wickedness; मा सख्युर्दक्षं रिपोर्भुजेम [[

.]] 
-क्षा 
__1 The earth. 
__2 An epithet of the Ganges. 
-क्षम् Strength, vigour. 
-Comp. 
-अध्वरध्वंसकः, क्रतुध्वंसिन्, -मथनः, -विध्वंसः Śiva; [[

.]] -m. epithets of Śiva.

__2 a lunar mansion. 
-जापतिः 
__1 the moon

-सावर्णः (र्णिः) N. of the 9th Manu; नवमो दक्षसावर्णिर्मनुर्वरुणसंभवः [[

.]]

(-ता) a lunar mansion. नरेन्द्रकन्यास्तमवाप्य सत्पतिं तमोनुदं दक्षसुता इवाबभुः [[

a. 
(-क्षी f.) Relating to Dakṣa. 
-क्षम् The south; [[

__1 A vulture. 
__2 An epithet of Garuḍa.

.]]] 
__1 Able, skilful, dexterous, competent, clever; इत्यम्बरीषं नाभागिमन्वमोदन्त दक्षिणाः [[

.]] 
__2 Right (opp. वाम). 
__3 Situated on the right side. दक्षिणं परी, दक्षिणं कृ to place any one on the right side as a mark of respect; ग्रहर्क्षताराः परियन्ति दक्षिणम् [[

.]] 
__4 South, southern; as in दक्षिणवायु, दक्षिणदिक्; आददे नातिशीतोष्णो नभस्वानिव दक्षिणः [[

.]] 
__5 Situated to the south. 
__6 Sincere, straightforward, honest, impartial. 
__7 Pleasing, amiable. 
__8 Courteous, civil. 
__9 Compliant, submissive. 
__10 Dependent. 
__11 Favourable; ‘दक्षिणः सरलावामपरच्छन्दानुवर्तिषु’

.]] 
-णः 
__1 The right hand or arm. 
__2 A civil or courteous person, applied in poetic compositions to a lover who professes attachment to one mistress, while his heart has been entirely taken up by another. 
__3 An epithet of Śiva or Viṣṇu. 
__4 The right-hand horse of a carriage; इन्द्रस्येव दक्षिणः श्रियैधि [[

.]] 
__5 The southern sacred fire. 
-णः, णम् 
__1 The right side. 
__2 The south; [[

.]] 
__3 The Deccan. 
-णम् The highest doctrine of the Śāktas 
-Comp. 
-अग्निः the southern fire, the sacred fire placed southwards; also called अन्वाहार्यपचन q. v. 
-अग्र a. [Page0797-2] pointing to the south. 
-अचलः the southern mountain. i. e. Malaya. 
-अत्ययः a dweller in the south. 
-अपर a. south-western. 
-अभिमुख a. facing the south, directed towards the south; [[

.]] 
-अयनम् the sun's progress south of the equator, the half year in which the sun moves from the north to the south, the winter solstice; सर्वेऽश्वमेधैरीजानास्तेऽन्वयुर्दक्षिणायनम् [[

.]] 
-अरण्यम् Daṇḍakāraṇya. 
-अर्धः 
__1 the right hand. 
__2 the right or southern side. 
-आचार a. 
__1 honest, well-behaved. 
__2 a worshipper of Śakti according to the right hand (or purer) ritual. 
-आम्नायः the southern sacred text (of the Tāntrikas). 
-आवर्त a. turning to the right (from the left), (a conch-shell). 
-आशा the south. °पतिः 
__1 an epithet of Yama. 
__2 the planet Mars. 
-इतर a. 
__1 left (as hand or foot); तमिमं कुरु दक्षिणेतरं चरणं निर्मितरागमेहि मे [[

.]] 
__2 northern. 
(-रा) the north.

-कालिका f.

__2 Durgā.

-पश्चिम a. south-western.

.]] 
-पूर्व, -प्राच् a. south-east. 
-पूर्वा, -प्राची the south-eastern quarter. 
-भागः the southern hemisphere. 
-समुद्रः, -सागरः the southern ocean. 
-स्थः a charioteer.

ind. 
__1 On the right or south of. 
__2 In the southern direction (with abl.) 
-णा 
__1 A present or gift to Brāhmaṇas (at the completion of a religious rite, such as a sacrifice). 
__2 Dakṣiṇā regarded as a daughter of Prajāpati and as the wife of Sacrifice personified; पत्नी सुदक्षिणेत्यासीदध्वरस्येव दक्षिणा [[

.]] 
__3 A gift, offering or donation in general, fee, remuneration; प्राणदक्षिणा, गुरुदक्षिणा &c.; cf. also दक्षिणाशब्दश्च परिक्रयार्थो भवति [[Ś. B. on
.]] Etymologically दक्षिणा is so called because it imparts power or strength to the receiver; दक्षकरणी हि दक्षिणा । दक्षश्च बलम् । [[ŚB. on
]]; दक्षिणा नाम दक्षतेरुत्साहकर्मणः । दक्षिणा उत्साहिका इति । [[ŚB. on

.]] 
__4 A good milch-cow, prolific cow. 
__5 The south. 
__6 The southern country, the Deccan. 
__7 Fame. 
__8 A kind of heroine thus defined:-- या गौरवं भयं प्रेम सद्भावं पूर्बनायके । न मुञ्चत्यन्यसक्तापि सा ज्ञेया दक्षिणा बुधैः ॥. 
__9 Completion of any rite. 
-Comp. 
-अर्ह a. deserving or worthy of a gift. 
-आवर्त a. 
__1 curved to the right (a conch-shell &c.); [[

.]] 
__2 turned towards the south. 
(-र्तः) 
__1 the Deccan. 
__2 a conch-shell opening to the right; [[Divyāvadāna 56. 71.]] 
-कालः the time of receiving Dakṣiṇd. 
-पथः 
__1 the southern part of India, the south or Deccan; अस्ति दक्षिणापथ विदर्भेषु पद्मपुरं नाम नगरम् [[

.]] 
__2 ‘the [Page0798-1] path of the दक्षिणा’, i. e. the cow, constituting the sacrificial cow. 
-प्रत्यच् a. south-western. 
-प्रतीची south-west.

-प्रवण a. inclining to the south. 
-बन्धः (in Sāṇ. phil.) the bondage of ritual or cermonial observances. 
-मूर्तिः m. a Tāntric form of Śiva. 
-युग्यः the right yoke-horse.

]] (where the word has sense 1 or 2 also).
